lines.text: Many learners say: She works like a nurse at the hospital.
Better: She works as a nurse at the hospital.
The first! He works as a driver.

data.wrong: She works like a nurse at the hospital.
data.right: She works as a nurse at the hospital.

native.tip: Para dizer qual é o trabalho de alguém, use “as”, não “like”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She works like a nurse at the hospital.” O certo é “She works as a nurse at the hospital.” Em português “como” serve para os dois, mas em inglês “like” compara e “as” diz a função. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “He works as a driver.” Agora diga em voz alta uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: To say what someone’s job is, use “as”, not “like”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She works like a nurse at the hospital.” The right way is “She works as a nurse at the hospital.” In Portuguese “como” covers both, but in English “like” compares and “as” gives the role. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
